FlashSfx.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / FlashSfx / base.Status / ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / InvokeDisplayAmountChanged / CanonicalVars / ExtraHoverTips / Cmd.Wait / CardCmd.Preview are presentation only -- the relic bar's glow, counter, sfx and hover text, and animation timing. The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.

AfterDamageReceived.issue: Rollup of guard G1 per binding rule 4. Every clause of the trigger is faithful -- owner, unblocked damage > 0, not-yet-used, draw 3 -- but the not-yet-used flag is never cleared, so the whole hook is dead from the second combat of the run onward.

AfterCombatEnd.issue: CentennialPuzzle.cs:53-57 exists for one reason: to clear UsedThisCombat. The sim implements neither this nor any other reset. This is the entire content of guard G1 and carries its LIVE label.

guards.what: G1 (LIVE): `_used_this_combat` is never reset, so the relic draws 3 cards in the first combat of a run and never again
guards.issue: MECHANISM: centennial_puzzle.py:22 sets the flag False in __init__ -- which runs ONCE PER RUN, when RunState.add_relic constructs the relic -- and :34 sets it True on the first HP loss. C# clears it in AfterCombatEnd (CentennialPuzzle.cs:53-57). Sim relic instances live on RunState.relics and are re-attached to every new CombatState, so combat 2 enters on_damage_received with the flag already True and returns. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed twice by two independent probes): `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-reset-exec` found this unit pool-wide (`_used_this_combat: False -> True` at combat-2 start, one of exactly three confirmed carriers), and `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py batch3` reproduces the observable directly -- `combat 1: _used_this_combat=True hand 5 -> 8` then `combat 2: _used_this_combat=True hand 5 -> 5`, where C# draws 3 in both. Both sides ported: Centennial Puzzle is COMMON in the transcribed grab bag (confirmed by `batch3-pool`), which makes it one of the most frequently offered relics in the game, and taking unblocked damage is the single most ordinary event in a fight. This was pre-diagnosed in .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md sweep A and is confirmed here, not rediscovered. Cheapest possible fix and shared with relic/belt_buckle, relic/burning_sticks and relic/paels_eye: clear the flag in on_combat_start.

guards.rationale: Structurally satisfied: on_damage_received is a combat hook, dispatched only from DamageCmd.deal inside a live CombatState (cmds.py:116-117).

The sim passes `hp_lost` -- the POST-block, post-HP-loss-modifier figure -- as the hook's `amount` (cmds.py:116-117), which is what DamageResult.UnblockedDamage holds. So a hit fully absorbed by block does not draw on either side, and a Tungsten-Rod-style reduction to 0 does not either. Checked because the sim's parameter is named `amount`, which reads like the pre-block number.

guards.what: N4: the killing-blow guard (PROMPT.md bug class 2)
guards.rationale: C# skips the victim's AfterDamageReceived when the hit killed it (`!WasTargetKilled || !originalTarget.IsDead`, CreatureCmd.cs:392); the sim guards the dispatch the same way (`if not target.is_dead:` before hooks.on_damage_received, cmds.py:116). Confirmed rather than assumed because this relic is exactly the shape that would expose it -- a fatal hit must not draw 3 cards. Rule 7: CreatureCmd.cs and cmds.py are not hashed here.

guards.what: N5: three separate `CardPileCmd.Draw(choiceContext, base.Owner)` calls (CentennialPuzzle.cs:46-49) vs one `DrawCmd.draw(player, 3)` (centennial_puzzle.py:35)
guards.rationale: Equivalent: DrawCmd.draw defers to player._draw (player.py:276-292), which loops once per card and per iteration re-checks the hand cap, consults should_draw, reshuffles the discard pile if the draw pile is empty, and fires on_card_drawn. That is the same per-card granularity as three separate Draw calls, including the mid-sequence reshuffle.
No AscensionHelper call in the file.

guards.what: N7: the `UsedThisCombat` setter only calls AssertMutable when the value actually changes (CentennialPuzzle.cs:30-37)
guards.rationale: A save-system mutability assertion with no gameplay reading; the sim assigns the field directly. Recorded because it is the same field guard G1 is about and a reader might mistake the setter for a guard.
